paper_title: Tur[k]ingBench A Challenge Benchmark for Web Agents
caption: Distribution of errors in a single run of GPT4 across all tasks
model_annotation: The figure is a donut chart titled "Distribution of Errors with GPT-4," consisting of seven colored slices forming a ring around a central empty circle. The slices are arranged clockwise, starting from the right side with a large blue slice internally labeled "Incorrect" in white text; a gray callout line connects a dot within this slice to external text reading "Incorrect" and "43.6%". Continuing clockwise, a red slice is internally labeled "Correct", with a callout line pointing to the external text "Correct" and "31.6%". Next is a yellow slice internally labeled "Partial", with a callout pointing to "Partial" and "11.3%". This is followed by a green slice that lacks internal text but is connected via a callout line to "Syntax Error" and "2.3%". Next, an orange slice is internally labeled "Unknown", with a callout line linking it to "Unknown" and "8.3%". Continuing clockwise, a thin teal slice is connected by a callout line to the top-left external label "Bad Response" and "1.5%". Finally, a thin light blue slice positioned between the teal and blue slices contains no internal text and has no connecting callout line or external label. For all labeled slices, the external annotations feature a category name in dark text positioned above its corresponding percentage in gray text.
